verdict.rationale: RingCentral's developer guide lists 'User Call Handling · State-based Rules · Interaction Rules · Call Handling Configurations', and auto attendant is a documented RingEX feature. This points to the product's own call handling varying by state, which plausibly includes open and closed hours. The evidence is only navigation headings, though, and never explicitly mentions business hours, closed behavior, holidays, or per-number scoping. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of business-hours schedules, distinct closed/after-hours routing, holiday schedule handling, per-number (vs per-user) configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can set business hours with open, closed, and holiday behavior per number
